privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.draftNotice: * This policy is a draft pending legal review. It will be finalized with professional review before we serve real customers, and is not indexed by search engines until then.
privacy.intro: Sotong provides multilingual salon consultation and after-service hair reports, and processes personal data as described below. This policy covers processing relating to customers.
privacy.controllerB: WADIDU (Representative: 최인묵, Address: 경기도 김포시 김포대로 699, 11층 1108호(풍무동, 드림시티), Contact: mook@wadidu.com). The salon you visit and the Sotong operator each process personal data according to their role.
privacy.purposeB: (i) Running the multilingual consultation (real-time translation); (ii) creating and delivering your after-service hair report; (iii) recognizing your history on return visits; (iv) with separate consent, using pseudonymized data to improve the AI service and train models. We do not use your data for other purposes.
privacy.itemsB:
· Required: language preference, requested service category, consultation messages, confirmation that you are 14 or older, consent records (timestamps)
· Optional: contact number, name, nationality, hair/style reference photos, before-and-after photos, free-text notes on style and concerns, recent treatment history, concern tags
· Only with separate consent: allergy status and related notes (health data)
· Entered by your stylist: face shape, crown volume, hair density, hair type, cowlick, gender, treatment records and notes, hair condition grade
· Generated automatically: a device cookie (sotong_did) and service operation logs
We do not collect your date of birth or age.
privacy.sensitiveB: Allergy information is health data and therefore sensitive. We collect and use it only where you have given **separate consent, distinct from other data**, and only to verify safety for chemical treatments. Declining does not restrict your service — we simply do not collect it, and your stylist will ask you directly before any chemical treatment.
privacy.retentionB:
· Automatically deleted **90 days after your visit**: contact number, original photos (references and before/after), free-text notes (style, concerns, allergy notes), consultation messages, the report's photos, requested style, concerns and cautions, and free-text-derived parts of the AI summary
· Retained after deletion: de-identified records such as service type, hair condition grade and satisfaction (for statistics), consent records, and the device identifier used to recognize return visits
· Pseudonymized training data you separately consented to is governed by section 7.
Deletion runs automatically every day and is irreversible.
privacy.thirdB:
· Google LLC (USA) — Gemini AI: real-time translation, consultation summary, report drafting. Data transferred: consultation messages, your free-text input (including allergy notes where separately consented), treatment and hair information. **Original photos are not transferred.** When/how: over the network during your consultation. Retention: until the purpose is fulfilled (under our paid terms, inputs are not used to train Google's models).
· Supabase Inc. — data storage. Storage region: **Korea (Seoul)**. Data transferred: all items listed in this policy. Retention: as in section 5.
· Vercel Inc. (USA) — service hosting and operational logs.
· Browser push services (Apple/Google/Mozilla, etc.) — only to notify stylists (no customer data; encrypted).
If you prefer no cross-border transfer, you may decline online check-in and ask for an in-person consultation at the front desk.
privacy.pseudoB: Only with your explicit consent do we pseudonymize your information — excluding name, contact details, free text and photos — and use it for statistics and AI model improvement, retained without a fixed time limit. If you also consented to photo training, photos of the treated hair are stored separately under a pseudonym. Pseudonymized data cannot identify you on its own, but re-identification remains possible if combined with additional information, so it is not fully anonymous. To withdraw consent, please contact the salon you visited or the operator.
privacy.cookieB: We use a device cookie (sotong_did, stored for 2 years) to recognize return visits and keep your consultation continuous. It is a random identifier and contains no name or contact details. You may delete it in your browser settings, though your visit history will then no longer be linked.
privacy.rightsB: You may request access, correction or deletion, suspension of processing, and withdrawal of consent. Because we identify customers only by a device identifier rather than a name or phone number, please include your consultation link (or your visit date and stylist) so we can verify and act on your request. Contact the salon you visited or the officer below.
privacy.securityB: We apply least-privilege and row-level access controls, encryption in transit (HTTPS), unguessable single-use tokens for consultation and report links, automatic deletion once the retention period passes, and access logging.
privacy.cpoB: Name/role: 최인묵 (CEO, also acting as Data Protection Officer) · Contact: mook@wadidu.com. Handles privacy enquiries, complaints and remedies.
privacy.changesB: If we change this policy we will post the changes on this page; material changes will be announced 7 days in advance (30 days where they significantly affect your rights or obligations).
